title: Elizabeth Barrett Browning's birth chart
metaDescription: Elizabeth Barrett Browning's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 15.3° Pisces. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Five of the nine placements whose signs are settled stand in Pisces — the Sun, Mercury, Venus, Mars and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 15.3° Pisces — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that the Moon, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: Mercury holds 7.5° Pisces, Venus holds 28.5° Pisces, Mars holds 9.5° Pisces — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that works by atmosphere; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Mars and Pluto hold the closest angle here — a conjunction, 1.0° wide. Two bodies in the same degree are not read as neighbours but as a merger: whatever one wants, the other is already funding. Behind it, Venus trine Neptune at 1.8°, and Mercury conjunction Mars at 2.0° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags four placements in this chart. Mercury in Pisces at 7.5° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Venus in Pisces at 28.5° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Jupiter in Capricorn at 4.5° is in fall; Saturn in Libra at 27.8° is in exaltation. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 5 water, 2 air, 1 earth, 1 fire by element and 6 mutable, 3 cardinal by mode. Water signs hold memory in the scheme, where nothing is quite finished and little is genuinely forgotten. Venus, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune were retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Virgo into Libra during that day at the birthplace, travelling 14.3° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
